sections.folderSetNote: The same pictures, file for file, whatever the folders are called. One is kept; the others can go whole.
sections.containedNote: Every photo in these folders also sits somewhere else, so the folder itself can go and nothing is lost.
sections.overlapNote: Two folders that hold some of the same pictures without either being a copy of the other — half a card re-imported, a "best of" pulled from several trips. Both folders stay: only the shared copies leave one side, and whatever each holds on its own is untouched.
sections.photoSetNote: Byte-identical copies of one picture — the same file twice. One is kept and the rest can go.
sections.nearSetNote: Pictures that LOOK the same but are different files. That can mean a resized or re-compressed copy — or two shots taken moments apart, which are two different photographs. Nothing here is a certainty: open them before deleting anything.

dupes.topLevelHint: Top level — directly in the library's own folder, not in any subfolder
dupes.takeOverFailed: Unable to take this cleanup over
dupes.markDeleteFailed: Unable to mark that copy for deletion
dupes.noActiveNote: A cleanup remembers what it found and what you decided, so you can stop and come back to it.
dupes.nothingToClean: No two photos here share a file size, so nothing can be a copy of anything. There is nothing to clean up.
dupes.worthChecking_one: {{count}} photo shares a file size with another one, which is the first thing a copy has to do.
dupes.worthChecking_other: {{count}} photos share a file size with another one, which is the first thing a copy has to do.
dupes.searchSr: Search this cleanup by folder, file or library
dupes.nothingScannedBody: The cleanup knows which libraries to compare. Run the scan and it will fingerprint anything new before looking — the first scan of a library can take a while, and you can leave the page while it runs.
dupes.unreadTitle: Some photos could not be read
dupes.unreadBody_one: {{count}} photo in this cleanup's libraries still has no fingerprint, so it was never compared. That usually means the library's storage was unavailable while the scan ran. Check the library is reachable and scan again.
dupes.unreadBody_other: {{count}} photos in this cleanup's libraries still have no fingerprint, so they were never compared. That usually means the library's storage was unavailable while the scan ran. Check the library is reachable and scan again.
dupes.nothingFound: This cleanup found nothing to remove. Finish it, and start another whenever you like.
dupes.noMatches: Nothing matches what you've narrowed this to.
dupes.checkingStill: Checking these are still as the scan found them…
dupes.deleteBody1_one: This {{count}} photo also sits in <bold>{{place}}</bold>, which is not touched.
dupes.deleteBody1_other: Every one of these {{count}} photos also sits in <bold>{{place}}</bold>, which is not touched.
dupes.deleteBody2: That is checked again the moment you confirm, against the library as it stands rather than as the scan found it. If a photo has been deleted, edited or moved since then, nothing at all is removed and this card says what changed.
dupes.deleteBody3: Each photo hands its tags, albums, collections and tagged people to the copy that survives it first. Everything removed goes to the Recycle Bin and can be restored until you empty it.
dupes.deleteBody3Folder: Only the photos go: the folder itself is left behind on disk, empty.
dupes.dismissBody1: This is a standing decision, not a note on this cleanup: no future scan will pair these again, on this page or the older ones. Nothing is deleted and no photo is changed.
dupes.dismissBody2: To set it aside for now and see it again next time, use <bold>Skip</bold> instead.
dupes.sweepBody1_one: Across <bold>{{count}} set</bold>, freeing about {{bytes}}. One copy of every picture stays, and each copy that goes hands its tags, albums and people to the one that survives it first.
dupes.sweepBody1_other: Across <bold>{{count}} sets</bold>, freeing about {{bytes}}. One copy of every picture stays, and each copy that goes hands its tags, albums and people to the one that survives it first.
dupes.sweepBody2: Only <bold>byte-identical</bold> copies — the same file twice, where the copies are interchangeable. Near-identical sets are never swept: those are different files, and each one is a judgement to make by looking.
dupes.sweepBody3: This follows the filters you have on, so it covers only what is on screen — {{shown}} of the {{all}} results this cleanup found.
dupes.sweepBody4: Every set is re-checked against the library first, exactly as deleting one at a time is. Any whose photos have moved since the scan is left alone and the rest go ahead. Everything removed goes to the Recycle Bin.
dupes.finishBody1_one: The cleanup is closed and kept as a record: {{count}} copy removed, {{bytes}} freed. Nothing more can be deleted from it.
dupes.finishBody1_other: The cleanup is closed and kept as a record: {{count}} copies removed, {{bytes}} freed. Nothing more can be deleted from it.
dupes.finishBody2_one: {{count}} result you haven't acted on will simply be found again by the next cleanup.
dupes.finishBody2_other: {{count}} results you haven't acted on will simply be found again by the next cleanup.
dupes.finishBodyNone: You can start a new cleanup straight away.
dupes.takeOverBody1: It becomes yours: you scan, review and delete, and {{name}} can no longer act on it. Everything it found and every decision already made is kept exactly as it is.
dupes.takeOverBody2: For when the person who started a cleanup isn't coming back to it — only one can be active at a time, so theirs holds the slot until it is finished, cancelled, or taken over.
dupes.cancelBody1: The cleanup stops and its list is discarded. Photos already moved to the Recycle Bin stay there — cancelling does not put them back, and nothing here empties the bin.
dupes.cancelBody2: You can start a new cleanup afterwards.
dupes.staleTitle: These have changed since the scan
dupes.staleBody: Nothing will be removed while this is true — the whole set is refused rather than the part that still matches, so no photo is ever deleted without the copy that was meant to survive it. Scan again to pick the change up.
dupes.staleModified: changed on disk since the scan
dupes.staleProtected: now in a library nothing may be deleted from
dupes.matchCertainHint: The same file, byte for byte. The copies are interchangeable.
dupes.matchLikelyHint: Matched on what the picture looks like, not on its bytes. Probably a copy — worth a look.
dupes.matchUnsureHint: Same size and dimensions but taken at quite different moments, so these may be two different photographs that merely look alike. Open them before deleting anything.
dupes.keeperGuessHint: Nothing you did separated these, so the choice came from the files themselves — resolution, size, which was added first.
dupes.keeperTossupHint: Nothing at all separated the copies, so which one stays was decided by a tiebreak. It makes no difference which survives.
dupes.heroIntro: One saved cleanup at a time: choose what to compare, scan once, and work through it whenever you like.
dupes.experimentalNote: Duplicate detection is still being proven. Check sets before deleting. Items go to the Recycle Bin and can be restored until emptied.
dupes.waitingToStart: Waiting to start — a library or face scan is using the disk. This carries on without you.
dupes.fingerprinting: Fingerprinting photos… {{percent}}%. This carries on if you close the page.
dupes.changedTitle: A library has changed since this cleanup started
dupes.changedBody_one: {{names}} is not what it was when this was set up. Anything affected is re-checked before it can be deleted, and will be refused rather than acted on.
dupes.changedBody_other: {{names}} are not what they were when this was set up. Anything affected is re-checked before it can be deleted, and will be refused rather than acted on.
dupes.openInGalleryTitle: Open “{{name}}” in the gallery, in a new tab
dupes.skipTitle: Take it off this cleanup. The next one will offer it again.
dupes.notSameTitle: These are not duplicates. No future scan will pair them again.
dupes.compareFoldersTitle: See both folders' photos side by side
dupes.lookTwoTitle: See both copies full size, side by side
dupes.overlapExplain_one: Both folders stay. Only this {{count}} photo — the one they hold in common — leaves “{{name}}”. Anything either folder has on its own is untouched.
dupes.overlapExplain_other: Both folders stay. Only these {{count}} photos — the ones they hold in common — leave “{{name}}”. Anything either folder has on its own is untouched.
dupes.markedDeleteHint: Marked for deletion — click to keep it instead
dupes.markedKeepHint: Marked to keep — click to delete it instead
dupes.shortfallHintDoomed: This copy has {{times}}× fewer pixels than the biggest one in the set.
dupes.shortfallHintKept: This copy has {{times}}× fewer pixels than the biggest one in the set — and it is the one being kept.
dupes.nearWarning: These only look alike. They may be two different shots — check before deleting.
dupes.keepsNothing_one: Nothing here is kept, so this removes the picture from your library, not just its spare copies. The copy goes to the Recycle Bin, where it can still be restored.
dupes.keepsNothing_other: Nothing here is kept, so this removes the picture from your library, not just its spare copies. All copies go to the Recycle Bin, where they can still be restored.
dupes.keepingSmall: A copy being deleted is much larger than the one being kept. Pixels can't be got back — check you're keeping the right one.
dupes.viewerNearTitle_one: {{count}} near-identical copy — check it before deleting
dupes.viewerNearTitle_other: {{count}} near-identical copies — check them before deleting
dupes.copyStatus: Copy {{index}} of {{count}} — use ← and → to step through them
dupes.inCommon_one: {{count}} photo the two hold in common
dupes.inCommon_other: {{count}} photos the two hold in common
dupes.noFilesToCompare: This result records no files to compare.

wizard.typeFoldersNote: Compare duplicate folders and their contents
wizard.typeFilesNote: Review duplicate photos or videos one by one
wizard.modeKeepHint: When copies are in several places, keep this one
wizard.modeClearHint: Keep the copies elsewhere and let this folder's go
wizard.step1Blurb: Choose which gallery libraries this duplicate cleanup job compares.
wizard.step2Blurb: Decide what the scan compares — whole folders or single files, and which media.
wizard.step3Blurb: Optional. Say in advance which folder a photo should be kept in when copies of it turn up in several — the scan then follows that instead of guessing.
wizard.step4Blurb: Review your selections before starting the duplicate cleanup scan.
wizard.noLibrariesBody: Create a gallery library before starting a duplicate cleanup job.
wizard.lockedHint: External: files here can be compared but never removed
wizard.unlockedHint: Internal: files here can be cleaned up
wizard.protectedBody: External libraries can be included for comparison, but files there cannot be cleaned.
wizard.aboutInstructionsBody: Nothing is inherited and nothing is shared: what you set here shapes this cleanup and no other. Clearing a folder out never empties it — a photo with no copy anywhere else is nobody's duplicate, and a set whose copies are all in cleared folders still keeps one.
wizard.findFolderAria: Find a folder in this list
wizard.noPhotosYet: These libraries hold no photos yet, so there is nothing to instruct.
wizard.whenCopiesAria: When copies are in several places, {{where}}
wizard.externalBlocked: "{{name}}" is external, so nothing can be cleared out of it
wizard.lockedBlocked: "{{name}}" is locked, so nothing can be cleared out of it
wizard.toFingerprint_one: {{count}} photo to fingerprint first — read from disk, so this can take a while. The rest of the {{total}} worth checking are already done.
wizard.toFingerprint_other: {{count}} photos to fingerprint first — read from disk, so this can take a while. The rest of the {{total}} worth checking are already done.
wizard.toCheck_one: {{count}} photo to check, all already fingerprinted — this scan will be quick.
wizard.toCheck_other: {{count}} photos to check, all already fingerprinted — this scan will be quick.
wizard.nothingToScan: Nothing here shares a file size with another photo, so there is nothing for a scan to find.
wizard.comparisonOnlyBody: They are always protected and cannot be cleaned or selected for deletion.
wizard.createsJobNote: This scan creates one active duplicate cleanup job assigned to the current user.
